description: Free. Creates a Stripe Checkout link for your human owner to pay by card: plan "bundle" ($5.00 for 1000 calls, default), "terminal" ($199/mo, 10,000 calls/mo), "team" ($599/mo, 50,000 calls/mo) or "full_tape" ($49/mo email). Send pay_url to your owner, then call check_owner_payment with claim_token until status is "paid"; the key is returned once.
name: request_owner_payment
